steps: Peel and dice Sweet potato into 1 cm cubes; finely dice Onion; mince Garlic and Ginger.
Heat Coconut oil in a large pot over medium heat, about 180 °C (350 °F).
Add Onion, Garlic and Ginger; cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until softened.
Stir in Cumin and Turmeric; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add Sweet potato, Cooked lentils, Unsalted vegetable broth and Coconut milk; stir to combine.
Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes, until sweet potato is very tender.
Add Green peas; simmer for 3 more minutes until peas are bright and soft.
Use an immersion blender to partially blend the soup to a creamy but slightly chunky texture.
Stir in Lemon juice; ladle into bowls for 4 family portions.
Refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 1 month.
